symptom: Ordinary browser navigation returns 403 and authenticated UI shows a login/session error
component: Command Center browser UI and API client
root_cause: UI supplied an approval claim without a durable approval receipt; client treated every 403 like 401
successful_fix: Omit the forged approval field and reserve logout/session handling for HTTP 401
verification_test: live headed browser navigation plus browser navigation/auth regression tests
regression_risk: Future UI actions may copy the forged approval pattern

symptom: API-key field renders but its Connect button is missing
root_cause: DOM appendChild was called with multiple children although it accepts one
detection_signal: source passes multiple arguments to appendChild
bad_approaches: testing only that button source text exists
successful_fix: Use Element.append for field, hint and button
verification_test: real Connect click loaded 431 catalog models plus Chromium regression
regression_risk: Multi-child UI construction can silently drop all but the first node

symptom: Failed acting task can finish as completed without matching file evidence
root_cause: Dotted tool name terminal.run matched a filename regex while use/write imperative phrasing was not classified
bad_approaches: treating registered tool names as file paths
successful_fix: Exclude registered/built-in tool names from filename evidence and recognize use/write action verbs
verification_test: focused parser tests and final action-contract regression
regression_risk: New dotted tool names or verb forms can bypass evidence inference

symptom: Approved Windows file mutation reaches executor but Python reports an unterminated string
root_cause: Quote-heavy Python source was nested inside a shell command and corrupted during transport
bad_approaches: counting tool dispatch as effect success
verification_test: rerun with argv-safe transport and independently reopen target file
regression_risk: Any generated shell command containing nested quotes

symptom: Browser screenshot visibly contains chart labels but model reports pixel values unavailable
root_cause: Screenshot tool returns a file path as text and no image pixels or OCR observation enters model context
detection_signal: independent image view shows pixel-only content
bad_approaches: claiming a screenshot path gives the model vision
verification_test: vision/OCR output must include bounding box, confidence and screenshot hash
regression_risk: False training facts from compressed video frames
